contact.note: Not yet contacted. Family-owned producer selling direct, based in Cape Town (Kapenhoek Rd area, 7550). Generic info@ alias taken from the site's contact page.

delivery.note: UNCONFIRMED. No shipping policy, courier, threshold or FAQ page was found on the shop page, a product page or the contact page. Free delivery is a hard requirement, so this needs a direct enquiry before the vendor can be considered. Silence on the site is not evidence that shipping is not free.

constraints: Small direct-from-producer catalogue: only five wines listed at time of scraping, three of them sold out (Langrug 2022, Putfontein Pinotage 2021, Witteberg 2023). In stock: Klipmuur 2024 (Sauvignon Blanc, R180) and Dorsland Pinot Chardonnay sparkling (R190).
Bottle range seen: R180-R200, which fits a typical day-to-day wine budget; budget-as-average (METHODOLOGY rule 2) applies.
Thin stock risk: with so few lines available, a multi-bottle order may be limited to one or two wines.

Also stocked by a third-party retailer: Wine Concepts On Kloof (Cape Town), per the contributor. Worth checking whether they carry these wines with their own delivery terms, since this producer's direct shop has no confirmed free shipping.
